title: Diagonal law for compatible transport
statement: Under the hypotheses of the compatible-transport structure [def-weil-pbc-finite-local-model-compatible-transport], transport along the same lift fixes every Q-point from any scheme.

A representation of a sheaf on the small etale site gives compatible transport on a representing scheme

from.place: Yoneda comparison, then diagonal and cocycle laws of local representatives

proof.text: Universal-point compatibility and naturality prove the identity law.

lean.statement: theorem finiteLocalModels_descentDatum_compatibility_transport_diagonal (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (U : T.Etale) (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale) (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj) (t : FiniteLocalModelCompatibleTransport T E U Q e) : ∀ (W : Scheme.{u}) (a : W ⟶ U.left) (x : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom), t.transport a a rfl x = x
